name: Clan Personalities
description: Living clans with personalities that talk AND fight. Five personas (Peaceful, Neutral, Altruistic, Aggressive, Player-Killing) drive world-chat drama written live by the pack's FPC brain: quarrels, taunts, threats, alliances and remembered grudges. When a feud boils over, the clans settle it in a real NPC-vs-NPC duel outside a town gate - fair level and gear matching, class roles (healers heal, mages cast), a gossiping crowd, gloating winners, and win/loss records with revenge that persist across restarts. Requires the FPC brain. Duels on by default (Phase2 = False for chat only).
author: thiag
